snippet.title: DHADAK 2 - OFFICIAL TRAILER | Siddhant Chaturvedi | Triptii Dimri | Shazia Iqbal | 1st August
snippet.description:
It all begins with ek धड़क! ❤️
#Dhadak2 TRAILER OUT NOW. 

Releasing in cinemas on 1st August.

Zee Studios, Dharma Productions & Cloud 9 Pictures present
A Dharma Productions Film
DHADAK 2
Starring Siddhant Chaturvedi & Triptii Dimri
Directed by Shazia Iqbal
Produced by Karan Johar, Umesh Kumar Bansal, Adar Poonawalla, Apoorva Mehta, Meenu Aroraa, Somen Mishra & Pragati Deshmukh
Co-produced by Marijke deSouza
Adapted Story, Screenplay & Dialogues by Rahul Badwelkar & Shazia Iqbal
Music supervised by Azeem Dayani

A Zee Studios Worldwide Release
